title: Home · Energy & heat pumps
description: Live values and history of the PV system (Sungrow SH20T) and heat pumps (Brötje BLW NEO).

panels.title: Battery
panels.description: Positive = battery discharges into the house, negative = battery is charging.

panels.title: Grid
panels.description: Positive = import from the grid, negative = feed-in.

panels.title: Self-sufficiency today
panels.description: Share of today's house consumption covered by PV and battery.

targets.expr: (1 - max by (appliance) (housevitals_daily_import_energy_kWh{appliance="inverter"}) / (max by (appliance) (housevitals_daily_direct_consumption_kWh{appliance="inverter"}) + max by (appliance) (housevitals_daily_battery_discharge_kWh{appliance="inverter"}) + max by (appliance) (housevitals_daily_import_energy_kWh{appliance="inverter"}))) and on(appliance) max by (appliance) (housevitals_up) == 1

panels.title: Reachable
panels.description: Last Modbus request succeeded. Nothing shown = the service delivers no data.

panels.title: PV forecast today
panels.description: Expected PV generation of the whole day (Open-Meteo, calibrated per array).

panels.title: PV forecast tomorrow
panels.description: Expected PV generation tomorrow.

panels.title: Performance ratio per array
panels.description: Measured / modelled energy of the past days per array. Clearly below the others: shading, soiling or a defect.

panels.title: SPF since commissioning
panels.description: Seasonal performance factor: heat delivered / electricity used, lifetime.

targets.expr: (max by (appliance) (housevitals_heat_delivered_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump1"}) / max by (appliance) (housevitals_electricity_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump1"})) and on(appliance) max by (appliance) (housevitals_up) == 1

(max by (appliance) (housevitals_heat_delivered_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump2"}) / max by (appliance) (housevitals_electricity_kWh_total{appliance="heatpump2"})) and on(appliance) max by (appliance) (housevitals_up) == 1

panels.title: Power
panels.description: Battery: positive = discharging, negative = charging. Grid: positive = import, negative = feed-in. Dashed: forecast PV power.

panels.title: Energy per day
panels.description: Daily totals from the lifetime counters. Today's bar grows until midnight (day boundaries in UTC).

targets.expr: sum by (appliance) (increase(housevitals_direct_consumption_kWh_total{appliance="inverter"}[1d] offset -1d)) + sum by (appliance) (increase(housevitals_battery_discharge_kWh_total{appliance="inverter"}[1d] offset -1d)) + sum by (appliance) (increase(housevitals_import_energy_kWh_total{appliance="inverter"}[1d] offset -1d))

panels.title: Heat pumps · electricity per day
panels.description: Electricity per heat pump and day, summed from the measured power (the heat pumps' energy counters are not updated continuously over Modbus).

panels.title: Flow and return
panels.description: Solid = flow, dashed = return.

panels.title: Hot water
panels.description: Solid = actual, dashed = setpoint (charged up to it), dotted = minimum (a charge starts below it). The heat pump keeps the minimum at least 5 K below the setpoint.

panels.title: Outdoor temperature
panels.description: Dashed: air temperature from the weather forecast (Open-Meteo, 2 m).

panels.title: Performance factor per day
panels.description: Heat / electricity per day, both summed from the measured power.

panels.title: Heat per day
panels.description: Heat delivered per heat pump and day, summed from the measured thermal power.

panels.title: PV power per string
panels.description: MPPT voltage × current.

panels.title: Grid power per phase
panels.description: Positive = import, negative = feed-in.

panels.title: Refrigerant circuit · pressures
panels.description: Solid = high pressure, dashed = low pressure.

panels.title: Refrigerant circuit · temperatures
panels.description: Solid = condensation, dashed = evaporation.

panels.title: Heat source & buffer tank
panels.description: Solid = heat source (inlet), dashed = buffer tank.

panels.title: Heat meter flow rate
panels.description: Litres per minute.
